role.rationale: Candles are primarily placed for aesthetics; light emission is secondary.

material_family.rationale: Crafted from honeycomb (wax) + string; wax is the primary constituent.

frequency.rationale: Placed for decoration; not a frequent-use consumable or tool.

activity.rationale: Primary purpose is decorating rooms, altars, and cakes.

flavor.rationale: Pink is a dye-color variant of the base (uncolored) candle.

palette.rationale: Pink reads as a warm pastel tone.

origin.rationale: Loot sources are self-block drops; item is crafted (white candle + pink dye).

environmental_property.rationale: Candles emit light up to level 3 per candle when lit.

primary_uses.rationale: Standard candle use cases in Minecraft.

role.rationale: Multi-use: throwable projectile and crafting ingredient; neither role alone dominates.

frequency.rationale: Used situationally for combat, snow blocks, or happy ghasts; not everyday.

activity.rationale: Thrown at blazes/ender dragon; crafted into snow blocks; tempts/feeds happy ghasts.

flavor.rationale: Gathered from natural snow; a basic elemental item.

origin.rationale: Mined from snow blocks on surface; snow golem drops; several chest loot tables.

material_secondary.rationale: Amethyst shard forms the optical lens in the recipe.

frequency.rationale: Pulled out to scout; not in constant use like weapons or tools.

palette.rationale: Copper body with an amethyst crystal lens.

schema_proposals.rationale: Colored items (candles, wool, concrete) need a dye_color facet for the 16 Minecraft dye colors; palette alone cannot express exact dye membership.
